audit.why: Even lane (5.5/10) fits 52% WR at 1248 games: Brand controls early with poke, Veigar overtakes at 2+ items. Content-layer prose already states this correctly.
Spikes are covered: Brand 3-5 poke window, Pyroclasm at 6, Veigar first item, Veigar late. All four spikes[] grounded in the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart rows 0-4 said 'Skill' while the content layer and the mechanics (Brand W 900-range poke + Blaze DoT vs pre-combo Veigar) say Brand. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit despite the kit giving Q 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 and W 10/9.5/9/8.5/8.
audit.why: Kit: Brand Q stuns only ablaze targets, W 900 range zone, E 13s spread, R 100s bouncing slow — all outrange or outpace pre-6 Veigar (E 20s cage is his only answer).
audit.corrected: Aligned rows 0-4 to Brand with rewritten whys; put real cooldowns in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: 52% Emerald+ figure in data; packet's 'chart contradicts 52%' defect resolves because Veigar's win rate comes from the 2+ items row, not early rows.

edits.before: Q through two units on every last-hit — each stack is permanent AP; the lane is a savings account from level 1.
edits.after: His Pillar poke and Blaze burn out-trade you before you have a combo — Q the two-unit last-hits and eat nothing free.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: Still his lane: the harass chunks you pre-combo — W only onto stunned targets, never onto open ground.

edits.before: Cage online: drop it ON yourself when he engages, behind him when he farms — the geometry does the fighting.
edits.after: Cage online but his 9s-cooldown W poke still wins — drop it ON yourself when he steps up to combo; don't fight it.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack off cannon waves. The curve is the matchup.
edits.after: He still out-pokes on W; Lost Chapter timing — Q-stack on cooldown and double-stack the cannon waves.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: Pyroclasm's bounces beat your single-target R in an even all-in — land the cage first or don't take the 6 fight.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Event Horizon (self-cage) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Brand Sear: matchup-defining — Q stuns only while you are ablaze, and it is back every 8s at rank 1 (6s max); after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. - Guard your E Event Horizon (20s at rank 1) like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Your R scales with missing health — the moment he dips below half in a trade, Primordial Burst turns his retreat into a kill.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Pillar of Flame is back every 8-10s and Blaze burns for 4s after it — standing in poke range on its cooldown donates your bar.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with W-E, landing the ablaze Sear stun, and chunking you out of lane before your curve pays.

notes: Full-layer chart rows 0-4 moved to Brand to agree with content win[0..4] (already 'Brand') — side edited alone per the chart rule, with rating and why rewritten in the same group. Rows 5 (Skill) and 6 (Veigar) already agree across layers. Packet defect about the chart contradicting the 52% WR is a misread: early-Brand/late-Veigar is exactly how a scaling champion wins 52%.
